topics.title: New GDPx benchmark shows top AI models still fail 88% of real economic tasks
topics.why: SemiAnalysis just launched GDPx, a 206-task agentic benchmark grounded in real paid work, and even the leader (Claude Opus 5.5) clears only about 12% — a reality check for knowledge workers being told AI can already do their job.

script:
Google just dropped Gemini 4 Carbon, and it's already rewriting the leaderboards. Announced October 28th, Carbon claimed the top spot on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index, outranking dozens of rival models, and posted 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro, a cybersecurity benchmark. Google built it for long-horizon tasks and network defense, but here's the catch: it is not generally available. Access is currently limited to verified defense partners through Google's Fairwind Program. So before you switch your stack chasing the best model, remember: rankings move fast, and today's leader can be locked behind a waitlist tomorrow.

I'm Nova. Stay ahead — for more AI news, subscribe to the link in the bio.
